evidence_items.publisher: Delip Rao, Eric Wong, and Chris Callison-Burch; arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: The 2026 audit classified some OpenAI Deep Research citation URLs as hallucinated, while distinguishing stale links from apparent fabrication. These product-specific results concern a general research benchmark, not measured dissemination of unreliable medical information or downstream harm.

This study reported favorable expert ratings for responses to 30 knee-arthroplasty questions using what the authors call ChatGPT-4o with DeepResearch. It cautions against treating all such medical output as unreliable, but does not measure population-scale dissemination or harm; 2026 identifies the reported finding because the test date was not established.
